```{r}
# Section 2
# Set up Python and IBM CPLEX
python_bin <- Sys.which(
  "python3"
)
if (python_bin == "") {
  stop(
    "python3 was not found. Install Python 3 before continuing."
  )
}
run_python_command <- function(args) {
  out <- system2(
    python_bin,
    args = args,
    stdout = TRUE,
    stderr = TRUE
  )
  status <- attr(
    out,
    "status"
  )
  if (is.null(status)) {
    status <- 0L
  }
  list(
    output = out,
    status = status
  )
}
check_cplex <- run_python_command(
  c(
    "-c",
    shQuote(
      "import cplex; print(cplex.__version__)"
    )
  )
)
if (check_cplex$status != 0) {
  cat(
    "Python CPLEX package not found. Attempting installation...\n"
  )
  system2(
    python_bin,
    args = c(
      "-m",
      "pip",
      "install",
      "cplex",
      "docplex"
    )
  )
  check_cplex <- run_python_command(
    c(
      "-c",
      shQuote(
        "import cplex; print(cplex.__version__)"
      )
    )
  )
}
if (check_cplex$status != 0) {
  stop(
    "CPLEX could not be imported into Python."
  )
}
cat(
  "Using Python:",
  python_bin,
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "CPLEX version:",
  paste(
    check_cplex$output,
    collapse = " "
  ),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
# Section 4
# Exact fixed-size best subset selection using CPLEX
best_subset_cplex <- function(
    X,
    y,
    s,
    M = 20
) {
  n <- nrow(X)
  p <- ncol(X)
  work <- tempfile(
    "cplex_"
  )
  dir.create(
    work
  )
  on.exit(
    unlink(
      work,
      recursive = TRUE
    ),
    add = TRUE
  )
  lpfile <- file.path(
    work,
    "model.lp"
  )
  solfile <- file.path(
    work,
    "solution.sol"
  )
  con <- file(
    lpfile,
    "wt"
  )
  # Objective
  writeLines(
    "Minimize",
    con
  )
  writeLines(
    " obj: [",
    con
  )
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " + 2 r_%d ^ 2",
        i
      ),
      con
    )
  }
  writeLines(
    " ] / 2",
    con
  )
  # Residual constraints
  writeLines(
    "Subject To",
    con
  )
  chunk <- 10
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    starts <- seq(
      1,
      p,
      by = chunk
    )
    for (cc in seq_along(starts)) {
      start <- starts[cc]
      finish <- min(
        start + chunk - 1,
        p
      )
      txt <- ""
      if (cc == 1) {
        txt <- sprintf(
          " resid_%d:",
          i
        )
      }
      for (j in start:finish) {
        a <- X[
          i,
          j
        ]
        if (abs(a) < 1e-14) {
          next
        }
        if (a >= 0) {
          txt <- paste0(
            txt,
            sprintf(
              " + %.12g beta_%d",
              a,
              j
            )
          )
        } else {
          txt <- paste0(
            txt,
            sprintf(
              " - %.12g beta_%d",
              -a,
              j
            )
          )
        }
      }
      if (finish == p) {
        txt <- paste0(
          txt,
          sprintf(
            " + r_%d = %.12g",
            i,
            y[i]
          )
        )
      }
      writeLines(
        txt,
        con
      )
    }
  }
  # Big-M linking constraints
  for (j in seq_len(p)) {
    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " U%d: beta_%d - %.12g z_%d <= 0",
        j,
        j,
        M,
        j
      ),
      con
    )
    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " L%d: - beta_%d - %.12g z_%d <= 0",
        j,
        j,
        M,
        j
      ),
      con
    )
  }
  # Exactly s predictors
  writeLines(
    " card:",
    con
  )
  chunk_z <- 25
  for (
    start in seq(
      1,
      p,
      by = chunk_z
    )
  ) {
    finish <- min(
      start + chunk_z - 1,
      p
    )
    txt <- ""
    for (j in start:finish) {
      txt <- paste0(
        txt,
        sprintf(
          " + z_%d",
          j
        )
      )
    }
    if (finish == p) {
      txt <- paste0(
        txt,
        sprintf(
          " = %d",
          s
        )
      )
    }
    writeLines(
      txt,
      con
    )
  }
  # Bounds
  writeLines(
    "Bounds",
    con
  )
  for (j in seq_len(p)) {
    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " -%.12g <= beta_%d <= %.12g",
        M,
        j,
        M
      ),
      con
    )
  }
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " r_%d free",
        i
      ),
      con
    )
  }
  # Binary variables
  writeLines(
    "Binary",
    con
  )
  for (
    start in seq(
      1,
      p,
      by = 25
    )
  ) {
    finish <- min(
      start + 24,
      p
    )
    txt <- ""
    for (j in start:finish) {
      txt <- paste0(
        txt,
        sprintf(
          " z_%d",
          j
        )
      )
    }
    writeLines(
      txt,
      con
    )
  }
  writeLines(
    "End",
    con
  )
  close(
    con
  )
  # Solve
  solve_start <- proc.time()[3]
  out <- system2(
    python_bin,
    args = c(
      shQuote(
        CPLEX_SOLVER_SCRIPT
      ),
      shQuote(
        lpfile
      ),
      shQuote(
        solfile
      )
    ),
    stdout = TRUE,
    stderr = TRUE
  )
  solve_seconds <-
    proc.time()[3] -
      solve_start
  if (!file.exists(solfile)) {
    cat(
      paste(
        out,
        collapse = "\n"
      ),
      "\n"
    )
    stop(
      "CPLEX did not produce a solution."
    )
  }
  # Status
  status_line <- grep(
    "^CPLEX status:",
    out,
    value = TRUE
  )
  cplex_status <-
    if (length(status_line) > 0) {
      sub(
        "^CPLEX status:[[:space:]]*",
        "",
        status_line[1]
      )
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }
  # MIP gap
  gap_line <- grep(
    "^MIP gap:",
    out,
    value = TRUE
  )
  mip_gap <-
    if (length(gap_line) > 0) {
      as.numeric(
        sub(
          "^MIP gap:[[:space:]]*",
          "",
          gap_line[1]
        )
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  # Read CPLEX XML solution
  sol <- readLines(
    solfile,
    warn = FALSE
  )
  beta <- numeric(
    p
  )
  z <- numeric(
    p
  )
  for (line in sol) {
    if (!grepl(
      "<variable",
      line,
      fixed = TRUE
    )) {
      next
    }
    name_match <- regmatches(
      line,
      regexec(
        'name="([^"]+)"',
        line,
        perl = TRUE
      )
    )[[1]]
    if (length(name_match) != 2) {
      next
    }
    name <- name_match[2]
    value_match <- regmatches(
      line,
      regexec(
        'value="([-+]?(?:[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]*)?|\\.[0-9]+)(?:[eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?)"',
        line,
        perl = TRUE
      )
    )[[1]]
    if (length(value_match) != 2) {
      next
    }
    value <- as.numeric(
      value_match[2]
    )
    if (grepl(
      "^beta_[0-9]+$",
      name
    )) {
      j <- as.integer(
        sub(
          "^beta_",
          "",
          name
        )
      )
      if (!is.na(j) && j <= p) {
        beta[j] <- value
      }
    }
    if (grepl(
      "^z_[0-9]+$",
      name
    )) {
      j <- as.integer(
        sub(
          "^z_",
          "",
          name
        )
      )
      if (!is.na(j) && j <= p) {
        z[j] <- value
      }
    }
  }
  selected <- which(
    z > 0.5
  )
  rss <- sum(
    (
      y -
        as.vector(
          X %*% beta
        )
    )^2
  )
  max_abs_beta <- max(
    abs(
      beta
    )
  )
  list(
    beta = beta,
    selected = selected,
    rss = rss,
    status = cplex_status,
    mip_gap = mip_gap,
    solve_seconds = solve_seconds,
    max_abs_beta = max_abs_beta,
    cplex_output = out
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 6
# Generate paired Monte Carlo datasets
#
# Population construction:
#
# Sigma_rho = (1-rho) I_p + rho 11'
#
# sigma^2 =
# beta*' Sigma_rho beta* / target_snr
#
# A common design, nested support, coefficients and raw
# N(0,1) noise direction are used across true model sizes
# within each replication.
generate_replication_base <- function(
    rep_id,
    n,
    p,
    rho,
    max_s,
    beta_min,
    beta_max,
    master_seed
) {
  set.seed(
    master_seed +
      rep_id
  )
  # Equicorrelated Gaussian predictors
  #
  # X_j = sqrt(rho) Z_0 + sqrt(1-rho) Z_j
  common_factor <- rnorm(
    n
  )
  Z <- matrix(
    rnorm(
      n * p
    ),
    nrow = n,
    ncol = p
  )
  X_raw <-
    sqrt(
      rho
    ) *
    matrix(
      common_factor,
      nrow = n,
      ncol = p
    ) +
    sqrt(
      1 - rho
    ) *
    Z
  # Population predictor covariance
  Sigma_rho <-
    (
      1 -
        rho
    ) *
    diag(
      p
    ) +
    rho *
    matrix(
      1,
      nrow = p,
      ncol = p
    )
  # Nested true support
  #
  # The first s entries are active for model size s.
  active_order <- sample(
    seq_len(
      p
    ),
    size = max_s,
    replace = FALSE
  )
  # True coefficients
  #
  # Coefficients are also nested across true model sizes.
  magnitudes <- runif(
    max_s,
    min = beta_min,
    max = beta_max
  )
  signs <- sample(
    c(
      -1,
      1
    ),
    size = max_s,
    replace = TRUE
  )
  beta_values <-
    signs *
    magnitudes
  # Common raw standard-normal noise direction
  #
  # Deliberately NOT centred or sample-standardised.
  epsilon_base <- rnorm(
    n
  )
  list(
    X_raw =
      X_raw,
    Sigma_rho =
      Sigma_rho,
    active_order =
      active_order,
    beta_values =
      beta_values,
    epsilon_base =
      epsilon_base
  )
}
make_dataset <- function(
    base,
    s,
    target_snr
) {
  X_raw <- base$X_raw
  p <- ncol(
    X_raw
  )
  # True support
  true_support <- sort(
    base$active_order[
      seq_len(
        s
      )
    ]
  )
  # True coefficient vector
  beta_true <- numeric(
    p
  )
  beta_true[
    true_support
  ] <- base$beta_values[
    seq_len(
      s
    )
  ]
  # Population signal variance
  #
  # Var(x' beta*) = beta*' Sigma_rho beta*
  population_signal_variance <- as.numeric(
    t(
      beta_true
    ) %*%
      base$Sigma_rho %*%
      beta_true
  )
  # Population noise variance
  #
  # target_snr =
  # beta*' Sigma_rho beta* / sigma^2
  sigma_sq <-
    population_signal_variance /
    target_snr
  sigma <- sqrt(
    sigma_sq
  )
  # Generate the response using the raw population design
  signal_raw <- as.vector(
    X_raw %*%
      beta_true
  )
  epsilon <-
    sigma *
    base$epsilon_base
  y_raw <-
    signal_raw +
    epsilon
  # Standardise predictors only after generating the response
  X <- as.matrix(
    scale(
      X_raw,
      center = TRUE,
      scale = TRUE
    )
  )
  colnames(
    X
  ) <- paste0(
    "X",
    seq_len(
      p
    )
  )
  # Centre response because methods use no intercept
  y <- as.numeric(
    y_raw -
      mean(
        y_raw
      )
  )
  # Realised sample SNR
  #
  # Diagnostic only.
  # It is not forced to equal target_snr.
  realised_snr <-
    var(
      signal_raw
    ) /
    var(
      epsilon
    )
  # Exact population-SNR check
  population_snr_check <-
    population_signal_variance /
    sigma_sq
  list(
    X =
      X,
    y =
      y,
    X_raw =
      X_raw,
    y_raw =
      y_raw,
    beta_true =
      beta_true,
    true_support =
      true_support,
    target_snr =
      target_snr,
    population_signal_variance =
      population_signal_variance,
    sigma_sq =
      sigma_sq,
    sigma =
      sigma,
    population_snr_check =
      population_snr_check,
    realised_snr =
      realised_snr
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 7
# Common helper functions
ols_refit <- function(
    X,
    y,
    support
) {
  support <- sort(
    unique(
      as.integer(
        support
      )
    )
  )
  p <- ncol(
    X
  )
  if (length(support) == 0) {
    return(
      list(
        beta = numeric(
          p
        ),
        fitted = rep(
          0,
          length(
            y
          )
        ),
        rss = sum(
          y^2
        )
      )
    )
  }
  Xs <- X[
    ,
    support,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  fit <- lm.fit(
    x = Xs,
    y = y
  )
  beta <- numeric(
    p
  )
  beta[
    support
  ] <- fit$coefficients
  fitted <- as.vector(
    X %*%
      beta
  )
  rss <- sum(
    (
      y -
        fitted
    )^2
  )
  list(
    beta = beta,
    fitted = fitted,
    rss = rss
  )
}
support_key <- function(
    support
) {
  if (length(support) == 0) {
    return("")
  }
  paste(
    sort(
      support
    ),
    collapse = ","
  )
}
safe_model_fit <- function(
    fit_function,
    model_size,
    ...
) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      ans <- fit_function(
        ...
      )
      ans$success <- TRUE
      ans$error <- NA_character_
      ans$k <- model_size
      ans
    },
    error = function(e) {
      list(
        success = FALSE,
        error = conditionMessage(
          e
        ),
        k = model_size,
        support = integer(
          0
        ),
        beta = numeric(
          0
        ),
        fitted = numeric(
          0
        ),
        rss = NA_real_,
        runtime = NA_real_,
        status = NA_character_,
        mip_gap = NA_real_
      )
    }
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 8
# CPLEX, COMBSS and ABESS wrappers
fit_cplex_model <- function(
    X,
    y,
    k,
    M
) {
  start_time <- proc.time()[3]
  fit <- best_subset_cplex(
    X = X,
    y = y,
    s = k,
    M = M
  )
  runtime <-
    proc.time()[3] -
      start_time
  support <- sort(
    as.integer(
      fit$selected
    )
  )
  if (
    length(
      support
    ) !=
      k
  ) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "CPLEX returned",
        length(
          support
        ),
        "selected variables when k =",
        k
      )
    )
  }
  # OLS refit on selected support
  refit <- ols_refit(
    X = X,
    y = y,
    support = support
  )
  list(
    support =
      support,
    beta =
      refit$beta,
    fitted =
      refit$fitted,
    rss =
      refit$rss,
    runtime =
      runtime,
    status =
      fit$status,
    mip_gap =
      fit$mip_gap,
    max_abs_beta =
      fit$max_abs_beta
  )
}
fit_combss_model <- function(
    X,
    y,
    k
) {
  start_time <- proc.time()[3]
  fit <- combss::combss(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    family = "gaussian",
    q = k,
    lam_ridge = 0,
    Niter = 100,
    alpha = 0.1,
    scale = FALSE,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  runtime <-
    proc.time()[3] -
      start_time
  if (
    length(
      fit$subset_list
    ) <
      k
  ) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "COMBSS did not return model size",
        k
      )
    )
  }
  support <- sort(
    as.integer(
      fit$subset_list[[
        k
      ]]
    )
  )
  if (
    length(
      support
    ) !=
      k
  ) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "COMBSS returned",
        length(
          support
        ),
        "predictors when k =",
        k
      )
    )
  }
  refit <- ols_refit(
    X = X,
    y = y,
    support = support
  )
  list(
    support =
      support,
    beta =
      refit$beta,
    fitted =
      refit$fitted,
    rss =
      refit$rss,
    runtime =
      runtime,
    status =
      NA_character_,
    mip_gap =
      NA_real_
  )
}
fit_abess_path <- function(
    X,
    y,
    k_values
) {
  total_start <- proc.time()[3]
  fit <- abess::abess(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    family = "gaussian",
    tune.path = "sequence",
    support.size = k_values,
    tune.type = "gic",
    lambda = 0,
    normalize = 0,
    fit.intercept = FALSE,
    early.stop = FALSE,
    warm.start = TRUE,
    num.threads = 1
  )
  total_runtime <-
    proc.time()[3] -
      total_start
  models <- vector(
    mode = "list",
    length = length(
      k_values
    )
  )
  for (
    ii in seq_along(
      k_values
    )
  ) {
    k <- k_values[ii]
    model <- abess::extract(
      fit,
      support.size = k
    )
    beta_hat <- as.numeric(
      model$beta
    )
    support <- sort(
      which(
        abs(
          beta_hat
        ) >
          1e-10
      )
    )
    if (
      length(
        support
      ) !=
        k
    ) {
      stop(
        paste(
          "ABESS returned",
          length(
            support
          ),
          "predictors when k =",
          k
        )
      )
    }
    refit <- ols_refit(
      X = X,
      y = y,
      support = support
    )
    models[[
      ii
    ]] <- list(
      success =
        TRUE,
      error =
        NA_character_,
      k =
        k,
      support =
        support,
      beta =
        refit$beta,
      fitted =
        refit$fitted,
      rss =
        refit$rss,
      runtime =
        NA_real_,
      status =
        NA_character_,
      mip_gap =
        NA_real_
    )
  }
  # ABESS native GIC estimate
  best_model <- abess::extract(
    fit
  )
  gic_size <- as.integer(
    best_model$support.size
  )
  list(
    success =
      TRUE,
    models =
      models,
    path_runtime =
      total_runtime,
    gic_size =
      gic_size,
    fit =
      fit,
    error =
      NA_character_
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 9
# L0Learn dense and adaptively refined path
fit_l0learn_path <- function(
    X,
    y,
    max_support,
    grid_points = 1200,
    upper_multiplier = 2,
    lower_multiplier = 0.02,
    refine_points_per_gap = 100,
    refine_rounds = 2
) {
  total_start <- proc.time()[3]
  max_support <- min(
    max_support,
    ncol(
      X
    )
  )
  # STEP 1
  # Pilot path
  pilot_fit <- L0Learn::L0Learn.fit(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    loss = "SquaredError",
    penalty = "L0",
    algorithm = "CD",
    maxSuppSize = max_support,
    nLambda = 100,
    scaleDownFactor = 0.80,
    screenSize = ncol(X),
    intercept = FALSE
  )
  pilot_lambda <- as.numeric(
    pilot_fit$lambda[[
      1
    ]]
  )
  pilot_lambda <- pilot_lambda[
    is.finite(
      pilot_lambda
    ) &
      pilot_lambda >
        0
  ]
  if (length(pilot_lambda) < 2) {
    stop(
      "L0Learn pilot path did not produce a usable lambda range."
    )
  }
  lambda_upper <-
    max(
      pilot_lambda
    ) *
      upper_multiplier
  lambda_lower <-
    min(
      pilot_lambda
    ) *
      lower_multiplier
  # STEP 2
  # Dense lambda grid
  lambda_grid <- exp(
    seq(
      from = log(
        lambda_upper
      ),
      to = log(
        lambda_lower
      ),
      length.out = grid_points
    )
  )
  run_cdpsi <- function(
      lambda_values
  ) {
    L0Learn::L0Learn.fit(
      x = X,
      y = y,
      loss = "SquaredError",
      penalty = "L0",
      algorithm = "CDPSI",
      maxSuppSize = max_support,
      lambdaGrid = list(
        lambda_values
      ),
      partialSort = TRUE,
      maxIters = 200,
      rtol = 1e-6,
      atol = 1e-9,
      activeSet = TRUE,
      activeSetNum = 3,
      maxSwaps = 100,
      screenSize = ncol(X),
      intercept = FALSE
    )
  }
  # STEP 3
  # Initial dense path
  fit <- run_cdpsi(
    lambda_grid
  )
  refinement_rounds_used <- 0
  # STEP 4
  # Refine support-size jumps
  if (refine_rounds > 0) {
    for (
      rr in seq_len(
        refine_rounds
      )
    ) {
      fitted_lambda <- as.numeric(
        fit$lambda[[
          1
        ]]
      )
      support_sizes <- as.integer(
        fit$suppSize[[
          1
        ]]
      )
      ord <- order(
        fitted_lambda,
        decreasing = TRUE
      )
      lambda_ordered <-
        fitted_lambda[
          ord
        ]
      size_ordered <-
        support_sizes[
          ord
        ]
      gap_indices <- which(
        abs(
          diff(
            size_ordered
          )
        ) >
          1
      )
      if (length(gap_indices) == 0) {
        break
      }
      extra_lambda <- numeric(
        0
      )
      for (i in gap_indices) {
        upper <- max(
          lambda_ordered[i],
          lambda_ordered[
            i + 1
          ]
        )
        lower <- min(
          lambda_ordered[i],
          lambda_ordered[
            i + 1
          ]
        )
        if (
          is.finite(
            upper
          ) &&
            is.finite(
              lower
            ) &&
            lower > 0 &&
            upper > lower
        ) {
          local_grid <- exp(
            seq(
              from = log(
                upper
              ),
              to = log(
                lower
              ),
              length.out =
                refine_points_per_gap +
                2
            )
          )
          local_grid <- local_grid[
            -c(
              1,
              length(
                local_grid
              )
            )
          ]
          extra_lambda <- c(
            extra_lambda,
            local_grid
          )
        }
      }
      if (length(extra_lambda) == 0) {
        break
      }
      new_lambda_grid <- sort(
        unique(
          c(
            lambda_grid,
            extra_lambda
          )
        ),
        decreasing = TRUE
      )
      if (
        length(
          new_lambda_grid
        ) ==
          length(
            lambda_grid
          )
      ) {
        break
      }
      lambda_grid <-
        new_lambda_grid
      refinement_rounds_used <-
        rr
      fit <- run_cdpsi(
        lambda_grid
      )
    }
  }
  # STEP 5
  # Extract only cardinalities that actually occur
  support_sizes <- as.integer(
    fit$suppSize[[
      1
    ]]
  )
  fitted_lambda <- as.numeric(
    fit$lambda[[
      1
    ]]
  )
  beta_path <- as.matrix(
    fit$beta[[
      1
    ]]
  )
  candidate_sizes <- sort(
    unique(
      support_sizes[
        support_sizes >= 1 &
          support_sizes <=
            max_support
      ]
    )
  )
  models <- list()
  model_counter <- 1
  for (k in candidate_sizes) {
    candidate_indices <- which(
      support_sizes ==
        k
    )
    valid_supports <- list()
    valid_refits <- list()
    valid_lambda <- numeric(
      0
    )
    valid_rss <- numeric(
      0
    )
    valid_counter <- 1
    for (index in candidate_indices) {
      beta_j <- beta_path[
        ,
        index
      ]
      support_j <- sort(
        which(
          abs(
            beta_j
          ) >
            1e-10
        )
      )
      if (
        length(
          support_j
        ) !=
          k
      ) {
        next
      }
      refit_j <- ols_refit(
        X = X,
        y = y,
        support = support_j
      )
      valid_supports[[
        valid_counter
      ]] <- support_j
      valid_refits[[
        valid_counter
      ]] <- refit_j
      valid_lambda[
        valid_counter
      ] <- fitted_lambda[
        index
      ]
      valid_rss[
        valid_counter
      ] <- refit_j$rss
      valid_counter <-
        valid_counter +
          1
    }
    if (length(valid_rss) == 0) {
      next
    }
    # At fixed cardinality the L0 penalty is constant.
    # Retain the observed solution with minimum OLS RSS.
    best_candidate <- which.min(
      valid_rss
    )
    best_refit <- valid_refits[[
      best_candidate
    ]]
    models[[
      model_counter
    ]] <- list(
      success = TRUE,
      error = NA_character_,
      k = k,
      support =
        valid_supports[[
          best_candidate
        ]],
      beta =
        best_refit$beta,
      fitted =
        best_refit$fitted,
      rss =
        best_refit$rss,
      selected_lambda =
        valid_lambda[
          best_candidate
        ],
      runtime = NA_real_,
      status = NA_character_,
      mip_gap = NA_real_
    )
    model_counter <-
      model_counter +
        1
  }
  if (length(models) == 0) {
    stop(
      "L0Learn produced no usable positive-cardinality models."
    )
  }
  model_sizes <- vapply(
    models,
    function(x) {
      x$k
    },
    integer(
      1
    )
  )
  ord <- order(
    model_sizes
  )
  models <- models[
    ord
  ]
  available_sizes <- sort(
    vapply(
      models,
      function(x) {
        x$k
      },
      integer(
        1
      )
    )
  )
  total_runtime <-
    proc.time()[3] -
      total_start
  list(
    success = TRUE,
    models = models,
    path_runtime =
      total_runtime,
    available_sizes =
      available_sizes,
    missing_sizes =
      setdiff(
        seq_len(
          max_support
        ),
        available_sizes
      ),
    number_distinct_sizes =
      length(
        available_sizes
      ),
    refinement_rounds =
      refinement_rounds_used,
    number_lambda_values =
      length(
        fitted_lambda
      ),
    fit = fit,
    error = NA_character_
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 10
# Construct complete CPLEX and COMBSS fixed-size paths
fit_fixed_path <- function(
    method,
    X,
    y,
    k_values
) {
  models <- vector(
    mode = "list",
    length = length(
      k_values
    )
  )
  for (
    ii in seq_along(
      k_values
    )
  ) {
    k <- k_values[ii]
    cat(
      "      ",
      method,
      " k = ",
      k,
      "\n",
      sep = ""
    )
    if (method == "CPLEX") {
      model <- safe_model_fit(
        fit_cplex_model,
        model_size = k,
        X = X,
        y = y,
        k = k,
        M = big_M
      )
    } else if (method == "COMBSS") {
      model <- safe_model_fit(
        fit_combss_model,
        model_size = k,
        X = X,
        y = y,
        k = k
      )
    } else {
      stop(
        "Unknown fixed-path method."
      )
    }
    models[[
      ii
    ]] <-
      model
  }
  successful <- vapply(
    models,
    function(x) {
      isTRUE(
        x$success
      )
    },
    logical(
      1
    )
  )
  runtimes <- vapply(
    models,
    function(x) {
      if (
        is.null(
          x$runtime
        )
      ) {
        return(
          NA_real_
        )
      }
      x$runtime
    },
    numeric(
      1
    )
  )
  path_runtime <-
    if (
      all(
        is.na(
          runtimes
        )
      )
    ) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      sum(
        runtimes,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    }
  list(
    success =
      all(
        successful
      ),
    models =
      models,
    path_runtime =
      path_runtime,
    error =
      if (
        all(
          successful
        )
      ) {
        NA_character_
      } else {
        "At least one fixed-size model failed."
      }
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 11
# Piecewise-linear breakpoint estimator
fit_linear_segment <- function(
    x,
    y
) {
  design <- cbind(
    1,
    x
  )
  fit <- lm.fit(
    x = design,
    y = y
  )
  coefficients <- fit$coefficients
  fitted <- as.vector(
    design %*%
      coefficients
  )
  residuals <-
    y -
      fitted
  list(
    intercept =
      coefficients[1],
    slope =
      coefficients[2],
    fitted =
      fitted,
    sse =
      sum(
        residuals^2
      )
  )
}
piecewise_breakpoint <- function(
    k,
    z,
    min_left = 2,
    min_right = 2
) {
  valid <-
    is.finite(
      k
    ) &
    is.finite(
      z
    )
  k <- k[
    valid
  ]
  z <- z[
    valid
  ]
  ord <- order(
    k
  )
  k <- k[
    ord
  ]
  z <- z[
    ord
  ]
  m <- length(
    k
  )
  if (
    m <
      min_left +
      min_right
  ) {
    return(
      list(
        success = FALSE,
        breakpoint_after_k =
          NA_integer_,
        s_hat =
          NA_integer_,
        total_sse =
          NA_real_,
        fitted =
          rep(
            NA_real_,
            m
          ),
        segment =
          rep(
            NA_character_,
            m
          )
      )
    )
  }
  candidate_indices <- seq(
    from =
      min_left,
    to =
      m -
      min_right
  )
  total_sse <- rep(
    NA_real_,
    length(
      candidate_indices
    )
  )
  for (
    ii in seq_along(
      candidate_indices
    )
  ) {
    split_index <-
      candidate_indices[
        ii
      ]
    left_index <- seq_len(
      split_index
    )
    right_index <- seq(
      split_index + 1,
      m
    )
    left_fit <- fit_linear_segment(
      x =
        k[
          left_index
        ],
      y =
        z[
          left_index
        ]
    )
    right_fit <- fit_linear_segment(
      x =
        k[
          right_index
        ],
      y =
        z[
          right_index
        ]
    )
    total_sse[ii] <-
      left_fit$sse +
      right_fit$sse
  }
  best_candidate <- which.min(
    total_sse
  )
  split_index <-
    candidate_indices[
      best_candidate
    ]
  left_index <- seq_len(
    split_index
  )
  right_index <- seq(
    split_index + 1,
    m
  )
  left_fit <- fit_linear_segment(
    x =
      k[
        left_index
      ],
    y =
      z[
        left_index
      ]
  )
  right_fit <- fit_linear_segment(
    x =
      k[
        right_index
      ],
    y =
      z[
        right_index
      ]
  )
  fitted_piecewise <- rep(
    NA_real_,
    m
  )
  fitted_piecewise[
    left_index
  ] <- left_fit$fitted
  fitted_piecewise[
    right_index
  ] <- right_fit$fitted
  segment <- rep(
    NA_character_,
    m
  )
  segment[
    left_index
  ] <- "Left"
  segment[
    right_index
  ] <- "Right"
  breakpoint_after_k <-
    k[
      split_index
    ]
  # Thesis definition:
  #
  # s_hat = b_hat + 1
  s_hat <-
    breakpoint_after_k +
      1L
  list(
    success = TRUE,
    breakpoint_after_k =
      as.integer(
        breakpoint_after_k
      ),
    s_hat =
      as.integer(
        s_hat
      ),
    total_sse =
      total_sse[
        best_candidate
      ],
    fitted =
      fitted_piecewise,
    segment =
      segment,
    left_intercept =
      left_fit$intercept,
    left_slope =
      left_fit$slope,
    right_intercept =
      right_fit$intercept,
    right_slope =
      right_fit$slope
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 12
# Threshold and breakpoint model-size identification
diagnose_model_path <- function(
    path,
    n,
    p,
    required_reference_k,
    required_k_values = NULL,
    require_complete_path = FALSE,
    ratio_floor = 1e-16,
    min_left = 2,
    min_right = 2
) {
  # Helper for failed diagnostic paths
  failure <- function(
      reason
  ) {
    list(
      threshold_available =
        FALSE,
      threshold_hat =
        NA_integer_,
      piecewise_available =
        FALSE,
      piecewise_hat =
        NA_integer_,
      breakpoint_after_k =
        NA_integer_,
      reference_k =
        NA_integer_,
      sigma_hat_sq =
        NA_real_,
      curve =
        NULL,
      failure_reason =
        reason
    )
  }
  # Basic path check
  if (
    is.null(
      path$models
    ) ||
    length(
      path$models
    ) ==
      0
  ) {
    return(
      failure(
        "No fitted model path was available."
      )
    )
  }
  # Keep successful fitted models
  valid_model <- vapply(
    path$models,
    function(x) {
      isTRUE(
        x$success
      ) &&
        is.finite(
          x$rss
        ) &&
        length(
          x$fitted
        ) ==
          n
    },
    logical(
      1
    )
  )
  models <- path$models[
    valid_model
  ]
  if (
    length(
      models
    ) ==
      0
  ) {
    return(
      failure(
        "No successful fitted models were available."
      )
    )
  }
  model_k <- vapply(
    models,
    function(x) {
      as.integer(
        x$k
      )
    },
    integer(
      1
    )
  )
  ord <- order(
    model_k
  )
  models <- models[
    ord
  ]
  model_k <- model_k[
    ord
  ]
  # CPLEX, COMBSS and ABESS require the complete path.
  #
  # L0Learn is allowed to skip cardinalities.
  if (
    require_complete_path
  ) {
    missing_required <- setdiff(
      required_k_values,
      model_k
    )
    if (
      length(
        missing_required
      ) >
        0
    ) {
      return(
        failure(
          paste(
            "Complete path unavailable. Missing k:",
            paste(
              missing_required,
              collapse = ", "
            )
          )
        )
      )
    }
  }
  # k_max must be available.
  reference_match <- which(
    model_k ==
      required_reference_k
  )
  if (
    length(
      reference_match
    ) !=
      1
  ) {
    return(
      failure(
        paste(
          "Reference model k =",
          required_reference_k,
          "was not available."
        )
      )
    )
  }
  keep <-
    model_k <=
      required_reference_k
  models <- models[
    keep
  ]
  model_k <- model_k[
    keep
  ]
  reference_index <- which(
    model_k ==
      required_reference_k
  )
  reference_model <- models[[
    reference_index
  ]]
  reference_k <-
    required_reference_k
  fitted_reference <-
    reference_model$fitted
  rss_reference <-
    reference_model$rss
  # Noise variance estimate
  #
  # sigma_hat^2 = RSS(k_max)/(n-k_max)
  sigma_hat_sq <-
    rss_reference /
    (
      n -
        reference_k
    )
  if (
    !is.finite(
      sigma_hat_sq
    ) ||
    sigma_hat_sq <=
      0
  ) {
    return(
      failure(
        "Reference-model variance estimate was invalid."
      )
    )
  }
  # Calculate Score(k), Level(k) and R(k)
  score <- rep(
    NA_real_,
    length(
      models
    )
  )
  level <- rep(
    NA_real_,
    length(
      models
    )
  )
  ratio <- rep(
    NA_real_,
    length(
      models
    )
  )
  for (
    ii in seq_along(
      models
    )
  ) {
    model <- models[[
      ii
    ]]
    k_i <- model$k
    # Score(k)
    score[ii] <- sum(
      (
        model$fitted -
          fitted_reference
      )^2
    )
    # Level(k)
    level[ii] <-
      4 *
      (
        sqrt(
          k_i
        ) +
          sqrt(
            reference_k
          )
      )^2 *
      (
        2 *
          log(
            p
          ) +
          log(
            n
          ) +
          1
      ) *
      sigma_hat_sq
    # R(k)
    ratio[ii] <-
      score[ii] /
      level[ii]
  }
  curve <- data.frame(
    k =
      model_k,
    score =
      score,
    level =
      level,
    ratio =
      ratio,
    is_reference =
      model_k ==
      reference_k,
    used_in_piecewise =
      model_k <
      reference_k,
    log10_ratio =
      NA_real_,
    piecewise_fit =
      NA_real_,
    piecewise_segment =
      NA_character_,
    stringsAsFactors =
      FALSE
  )
  # THRESHOLD ESTIMATOR
  #
  # s_hat = min{k < k_max : R(k) <= 1}
  #
  # k_max is excluded because R(k_max) = 0 by construction.
  #
  # If no earlier crossing occurs, the threshold estimate is
  # recorded as unavailable.
  qualifying <- curve$k[
    is.finite(
      curve$ratio
    ) &
      curve$k <
      reference_k &
      curve$ratio <=
      1
  ]
  threshold_hat <-
    if (
      length(
        qualifying
      ) >
        0
    ) {
      min(
        qualifying
      )
    } else {
      NA_integer_
    }
  threshold_available <-
    !is.na(
      threshold_hat
    )
  # PIECEWISE BREAKPOINT ESTIMATOR
  #
  # k_max is excluded because R(k_max) = 0.
  #
  # z_k = log10 R(k)
  piecewise_indices <- which(
    curve$k <
      reference_k
  )
  piecewise_k <- curve$k[
    piecewise_indices
  ]
  piecewise_ratio <- curve$ratio[
    piecewise_indices
  ]
  piecewise_z <- log10(
    pmax(
      piecewise_ratio,
      ratio_floor
    )
  )
  curve$log10_ratio[
    piecewise_indices
  ] <- piecewise_z
  breakpoint <- piecewise_breakpoint(
    k =
      piecewise_k,
    z =
      piecewise_z,
    min_left =
      min_left,
    min_right =
      min_right
  )
  piecewise_available <-
    isTRUE(
      breakpoint$success
    )
  piecewise_hat <-
    if (
      piecewise_available
    ) {
      breakpoint$s_hat
    } else {
      NA_integer_
    }
  breakpoint_after_k <-
    if (
      piecewise_available
    ) {
      breakpoint$breakpoint_after_k
    } else {
      NA_integer_
    }
  if (
    piecewise_available
  ) {
    curve$piecewise_fit[
      piecewise_indices
    ] <- breakpoint$fitted
    curve$piecewise_segment[
      piecewise_indices
    ] <- breakpoint$segment
  }
  list(
    threshold_available =
      threshold_available,
    threshold_hat =
      threshold_hat,
    piecewise_available =
      piecewise_available,
    piecewise_hat =
      piecewise_hat,
    breakpoint_after_k =
      breakpoint_after_k,
    breakpoint_sse =
      if (
        piecewise_available
      ) {
        breakpoint$total_sse
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
    left_intercept =
      if (
        piecewise_available
      ) {
        breakpoint$left_intercept
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
    left_slope =
      if (
        piecewise_available
      ) {
        breakpoint$left_slope
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
    right_intercept =
      if (
        piecewise_available
      ) {
        breakpoint$right_intercept
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
    right_slope =
      if (
        piecewise_available
      ) {
        breakpoint$right_slope
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
    reference_k =
      reference_k,
    sigma_hat_sq =
      sigma_hat_sq,
    curve =
      curve,
    failure_reason =
      NA_character_
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 13
# Result table helper functions
path_to_table <- function(
    path,
    rep_id,
    s_true,
    method
) {
  if (
    is.null(
      path$models
    ) ||
    length(
      path$models
    ) ==
      0
  ) {
    return(
      data.frame()
    )
  }
  rows <- vector(
    mode = "list",
    length = length(
      path$models
    )
  )
  for (
    ii in seq_along(
      path$models
    )
  ) {
    model <- path$models[[
      ii
    ]]
    rows[[
      ii
    ]] <- data.frame(
      rep =
        rep_id,
      s_true =
        s_true,
      method =
        method,
      k =
        model$k,
      success =
        isTRUE(
          model$success
        ),
      support =
        if (
          isTRUE(
            model$success
          )
        ) {
          support_key(
            model$support
          )
        } else {
          NA_character_
        },
      rss =
        model$rss,
      runtime =
        model$runtime,
      path_runtime =
        path$path_runtime,
      cplex_status =
        if (
          is.null(
            model$status
          )
        ) {
          NA_character_
        } else {
          model$status
        },
      cplex_gap =
        if (
          is.null(
            model$mip_gap
          )
        ) {
          NA_real_
        } else {
          model$mip_gap
        },
      error =
        if (
          is.null(
            model$error
          )
        ) {
          NA_character_
        } else {
          model$error
        },
      stringsAsFactors =
        FALSE
    )
  }
  bind_rows(
    rows
  )
}
make_identification_row <- function(
    rep_id,
    s_true,
    method,
    estimator,
    s_hat,
    path_runtime = NA_real_,
    reference_k = NA_integer_,
    failure_reason = NA_character_
) {
  estimate_available <-
    !is.na(
      s_hat
    )
  data.frame(
    rep =
      rep_id,
    s_true =
      s_true,
    method =
      method,
    estimator =
      estimator,
    s_hat =
      if (
        estimate_available
      ) {
        as.integer(
          s_hat
        )
      } else {
        NA_integer_
      },
    estimate_available =
      estimate_available,
    correct =
      if (
        estimate_available
      ) {
        s_hat ==
        s_true
      } else {
        FALSE
      },
    absolute_error =
      if (
        estimate_available
      ) {
        abs(
          s_hat -
          s_true
        )
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
    signed_error =
      if (
        estimate_available
      ) {
        s_hat -
        s_true
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
    reference_k =
      reference_k,
    path_runtime =
      path_runtime,
    failure_reason =
      failure_reason,
    stringsAsFactors =
      FALSE
  )
}
diagnostic_identification_rows <- function(
    diagnostic,
    rep_id,
    s_true,
    method,
    path_runtime
) {
  threshold_reason <-
    if (
      diagnostic$threshold_available
    ) {
      NA_character_
    } else {
      diagnostic$failure_reason
    }
  piecewise_reason <-
    if (
      diagnostic$piecewise_available
    ) {
      NA_character_
    } else {
      diagnostic$failure_reason
    }
  bind_rows(
    make_identification_row(
      rep_id =
        rep_id,
      s_true =
        s_true,
      method =
        method,
      estimator =
        "Threshold",
      s_hat =
        diagnostic$threshold_hat,
      path_runtime =
        path_runtime,
      reference_k =
        diagnostic$reference_k,
      failure_reason =
        threshold_reason
    ),
    make_identification_row(
      rep_id =
        rep_id,
      s_true =
        s_true,
      method =
        method,
      estimator =
        "Breakpoint",
      s_hat =
        diagnostic$piecewise_hat,
      path_runtime =
        path_runtime,
      reference_k =
        diagnostic$reference_k,
      failure_reason =
        piecewise_reason
    )
  )
}
diagnostic_curve_table <- function(
    diagnostic,
    rep_id,
    s_true,
    method
) {
  if (
    is.null(
      diagnostic$curve
    )
  ) {
    return(
      data.frame()
    )
  }
  diagnostic$curve %>%
    mutate(
      rep =
        rep_id,
      s_true =
        s_true,
      method =
        method,
      threshold_hat =
        diagnostic$threshold_hat,
      piecewise_hat =
        diagnostic$piecewise_hat,
      breakpoint_after_k =
        diagnostic$breakpoint_after_k,
      reference_k =
        diagnostic$reference_k
    ) %>%
    select(
      rep,
      s_true,
      method,
      k,
      score,
      level,
      ratio,
      log10_ratio,
      is_reference,
      used_in_piecewise,
      piecewise_fit,
      piecewise_segment,
      threshold_hat,
      piecewise_hat,
      breakpoint_after_k,
      reference_k
    )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 15
# Main Monte Carlo experiment
# Namespace-safe diagnostic curve table
#
# This explicitly uses dplyr:: functions to avoid the
# select() masking error caused by another loaded package.
diagnostic_curve_table <- function(
    diagnostic,
    rep_id,
    s_true,
    method
) {
  if (
    is.null(
      diagnostic$curve
    )
  ) {
    return(
      data.frame()
    )
  }
  diagnostic$curve %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      rep =
        rep_id,
      s_true =
        s_true,
      method =
        method,
      threshold_hat =
        diagnostic$threshold_hat,
      piecewise_hat =
        diagnostic$piecewise_hat,
      breakpoint_after_k =
        diagnostic$breakpoint_after_k,
      reference_k =
        diagnostic$reference_k
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      rep,
      s_true,
      method,
      k,
      score,
      level,
      ratio,
      log10_ratio,
      is_reference,
      used_in_piecewise,
      piecewise_fit,
      piecewise_segment,
      threshold_hat,
      piecewise_hat,
      breakpoint_after_k,
      reference_k
    )
}
# Storage objects
identification_list <- list()
path_results_list <- list()
diagnostic_curve_list <- list()
dgp_diagnostics_list <- list()
identification_counter <- 1
path_counter <- 1
curve_counter <- 1
dgp_counter <- 1
experiment_start <- Sys.time()
# Monte Carlo loop
for (
  r in seq_len(
    n_rep
  )
) {
  cat(
    "\n============================================================\n"
  )
  cat(
    "REPLICATION",
    r,
    "OF",
    n_rep,
    "\n"
  )
  cat(
    "============================================================\n"
  )
  # Generate one common replication base
  #
  # The same predictor matrix, active-variable ordering,
  # coefficient values and raw Gaussian noise direction are
  # used across the different true model sizes.
  base <- generate_replication_base(
    rep_id =
      r,
    n =
      n,
    p =
      p,
    rho =
      rho,
    max_s =
      max_true_size,
    beta_min =
      beta_min,
    beta_max =
      beta_max,
    master_seed =
      master_seed
  )
  # Loop over true model sizes
  for (
    s_true in true_sizes
  ) {
    cat(
      "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n"
    )
    cat(
      "TRUE MODEL SIZE s* =",
      s_true,
      "\n"
    )
    cat(
      "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
    )
    # Construct dataset for this true model size
    data <- make_dataset(
      base =
        base,
      s =
        s_true,
      target_snr =
        target_snr
    )
    # Save DGP diagnostics
    dgp_diagnostics_list[[
      dgp_counter
    ]] <- data.frame(
      rep =
        r,
      s_true =
        s_true,
      target_snr =
        data$target_snr,
      population_signal_variance =
        data$population_signal_variance,
      sigma_sq =
        data$sigma_sq,
      sigma =
        data$sigma,
      population_snr_check =
        data$population_snr_check,
      realised_snr =
        data$realised_snr,
      true_support =
        paste(
          data$true_support,
          collapse = ","
        ),
      stringsAsFactors =
        FALSE
    )
    dgp_counter <-
      dgp_counter +
        1
    # DGP output
    cat(
      "True support:",
      paste(
        data$true_support,
        collapse = ", "
      ),
      "\n"
    )
    cat(
      "Population signal variance:",
      round(
        data$population_signal_variance,
        6
      ),
      "\n"
    )
    cat(
      "Population sigma^2:",
      round(
        data$sigma_sq,
        6
      ),
      "\n"
    )
    cat(
      "Population SNR check:",
      round(
        data$population_snr_check,
        6
      ),
      "\n"
    )
    cat(
      "Realised sample SNR:",
      round(
        data$realised_snr,
        6
      ),
      "\n"
    )
    # CPLEX
    cat(
      "\n  Fitting CPLEX path...\n"
    )
    cplex_path <- fit_fixed_path(
      method =
        "CPLEX",
      X =
        data$X,
      y =
        data$y,
      k_values =
        k_values
    )
    cplex_diag <- diagnose_model_path(
      path =
        cplex_path,
      n =
        n,
      p =
        p,
      required_reference_k =
        k_max,
      required_k_values =
        k_values,
      require_complete_path =
        TRUE,
      ratio_floor =
        ratio_floor,
      min_left =
        min_left_points,
      min_right =
        min_right_points
    )
    identification_list[[
      identification_counter
    ]] <- diagnostic_identification_rows(
      diagnostic =
        cplex_diag,
      rep_id =
        r,
      s_true =
        s_true,
      method =
        "CPLEX",
      path_runtime =
        cplex_path$path_runtime
    )
    identification_counter <-
      identification_counter +
        1
    path_results_list[[
      path_counter
    ]] <- path_to_table(
      path =
        cplex_path,
      rep_id =
        r,
      s_true =
        s_true,
      method =
        "CPLEX"
    )
    path_counter <-
      path_counter +
        1
    diagnostic_curve_list[[
      curve_counter
    ]] <- diagnostic_curve_table(
      diagnostic =
        cplex_diag,
      rep_id =
        r,
      s_true =
        s_true,
      method =
        "CPLEX"
    )
    curve_counter <-
      curve_counter +
        1
    # COMBSS
    cat(
      "\n  Fitting COMBSS path...\n"
    )
    combss_path <- fit_fixed_path(
      method =
        "COMBSS",
      X =
        data$X,
      y =
        data$y,
      k_values =
        k_values
    )
    combss_diag <- diagnose_model_path(
      path =
        combss_path,
      n =
        n,
      p =
        p,
      required_reference_k =
        k_max,
      required_k_values =
        k_values,
      require_complete_path =
        TRUE,
      ratio_floor =
        ratio_floor,
      min_left =
        min_left_points,
      min_right =
        min_right_points
    )
    identification_list[[
      identification_counter
    ]] <- diagnostic_identification_rows(
      diagnostic =
        combss_diag,
      rep_id =
        r,
      s_true =
        s_true,
      method =
        "COMBSS",
      path_runtime =
        combss_path$path_runtime
    )
    identification_counter <-
      identification_counter +
        1
    path_results_list[[
      path_counter
    ]] <- path_to_table(
      path =
        combss_path,
      rep_id =
        r,
      s_true =
        s_true,
      method =
        "COMBSS"
    )
    path_counter <-
      path_counter +
        1
    diagnostic_curve_list[[
      curve_counter
    ]] <- diagnostic_curve_table(
      diagnostic =
        combss_diag,
      rep_id =
        r,
      s_true =
        s_true,
      method =
        "COMBSS"
    )
    curve_counter <-
      curve_counter +
        1
    # ABESS
    cat(
      "\n  Fitting ABESS path...\n"
    )
    abess_path <- tryCatch(
      {
        fit_abess_path(
          X =
            data$X,
          y =
            data$y,
          k_values =
            k_values
        )
      },
      error = function(e) {
        list(
          success =
            FALSE,
          models =
            NULL,
          path_runtime =
            NA_real_,
          gic_size =
            NA_integer_,
          error =
            conditionMessage(
              e
            )
        )
      }
    )
    abess_diag <- diagnose_model_path(
      path =
        abess_path,
      n =
        n,
      p =
        p,
      required_reference_k =
        k_max,
      required_k_values =
        k_values,
      require_complete_path =
        TRUE,
      ratio_floor =
        ratio_floor,
      min_left =
        min_left_points,
      min_right =
        min_right_points
    )
    identification_list[[
      identification_counter
    ]] <- diagnostic_identification_rows(
      diagnostic =
        abess_diag,
      rep_id =
        r,
      s_true =
        s_true,
      method =
        "ABESS",
      path_runtime =
        abess_path$path_runtime
    )
    identification_counter <-
      identification_counter +
        1
    # ABESS native GIC estimate
    identification_list[[
      identification_counter
    ]] <- make_identification_row(
      rep_id =
        r,
      s_true =
        s_true,
      method =
        "ABESS",
      estimator =
        "GIC",
      s_hat =
        abess_path$gic_size,
      path_runtime =
        abess_path$path_runtime,
      reference_k =
        NA_integer_,
      failure_reason =
        if (
          is.na(
            abess_path$gic_size
          )
        ) {
          abess_path$error
        } else {
          NA_character_
        }
    )
    identification_counter <-
      identification_counter +
        1
    if (
      !is.null(
        abess_path$models
      )
    ) {
      path_results_list[[
        path_counter
      ]] <- path_to_table(
        path =
          abess_path,
        rep_id =
          r,
        s_true =
          s_true,
        method =
          "ABESS"
      )
      path_counter <-
        path_counter +
          1
    }
    diagnostic_curve_list[[
      curve_counter
    ]] <- diagnostic_curve_table(
      diagnostic =
        abess_diag,
      rep_id =
        r,
      s_true =
        s_true,
      method =
        "ABESS"
    )
    curve_counter <-
      curve_counter +
        1
    # L0Learn
    cat(
      "\n  Fitting L0Learn path...\n"
    )
    l0_path <- tryCatch(
      {
        fit_l0learn_path(
          X =
            data$X,
          y =
            data$y,
          max_support =
            l0_max_support,
          grid_points =
            l0_grid_points,
          upper_multiplier =
            l0_upper_multiplier,
          lower_multiplier =
            l0_lower_multiplier,
          refine_points_per_gap =
            l0_refine_points_per_gap,
          refine_rounds =
            l0_refine_rounds
        )
      },
      error = function(e) {
        list(
          success =
            FALSE,
          models =
            NULL,
          path_runtime =
            NA_real_,
          available_sizes =
            integer(
              0
            ),
          missing_sizes =
            k_values,
          error =
            conditionMessage(
              e
            )
        )
      }
    )
    l0_diag <- diagnose_model_path(
      path =
        l0_path,
      n =
        n,
      p =
        p,
      required_reference_k =
        k_max,
      required_k_values =
        k_values,
      # L0Learn is permitted to skip cardinalities.
      require_complete_path =
        FALSE,
      ratio_floor =
        ratio_floor,
      min_left =
        min_left_points,
      min_right =
        min_right_points
    )
    identification_list[[
      identification_counter
    ]] <- diagnostic_identification_rows(
      diagnostic =
        l0_diag,
      rep_id =
        r,
      s_true =
        s_true,
      method =
        "L0Learn",
      path_runtime =
        l0_path$path_runtime
    )
    identification_counter <-
      identification_counter +
        1
    if (
      !is.null(
        l0_path$models
      )
    ) {
      path_results_list[[
        path_counter
      ]] <- path_to_table(
        path =
          l0_path,
        rep_id =
          r,
        s_true =
          s_true,
        method =
          "L0Learn"
      )
      path_counter <-
        path_counter +
          1
    }
    diagnostic_curve_list[[
      curve_counter
    ]] <- diagnostic_curve_table(
      diagnostic =
        l0_diag,
      rep_id =
        r,
      s_true =
        s_true,
      method =
        "L0Learn"
    )
    curve_counter <-
      curve_counter +
        1
    # Progress output
    cat(
      "\n  Estimates:\n"
    )
    cat(
      "    CPLEX:",
      "Threshold =",
      cplex_diag$threshold_hat,
      "| Breakpoint =",
      cplex_diag$piecewise_hat,
      "\n"
    )
    cat(
      "    COMBSS:",
      "Threshold =",
      combss_diag$threshold_hat,
      "| Breakpoint =",
      combss_diag$piecewise_hat,
      "\n"
    )
    cat(
      "    ABESS:",
      "Threshold =",
      abess_diag$threshold_hat,
      "| Breakpoint =",
      abess_diag$piecewise_hat,
      "| GIC =",
      abess_path$gic_size,
      "\n"
    )
    cat(
      "    L0Learn:",
      "Threshold =",
      l0_diag$threshold_hat,
      "| Breakpoint =",
      l0_diag$piecewise_hat,
      "\n"
    )
    if (
      !is.null(
        l0_path$available_sizes
      )
    ) {
      cat(
        "    L0Learn available sizes:",
        paste(
          l0_path$available_sizes,
          collapse = ", "
        ),
        "\n"
      )
    }
  }
  # Save checkpoint after each completed replication
  checkpoint <- list(
    completed_replication =
      r,
    dgp_diagnostics =
      dplyr::bind_rows(
        dgp_diagnostics_list
      ),
    identification_results =
      dplyr::bind_rows(
        identification_list
      ),
    path_results =
      dplyr::bind_rows(
        path_results_list
      ),
    diagnostic_curves =
      dplyr::bind_rows(
        diagnostic_curve_list
      )
  )
  saveRDS(
    checkpoint,
    checkpoint_file
  )
  cat(
    "\nCheckpoint saved after replication",
    r,
    "\n"
  )
}
# Experiment timing
experiment_end <- Sys.time()
cat(

)
cat(

cat(

cat(
```

```{r}
# Section 17
# Model-size identification summaries
mean_safe <- function(
    x
) {
  if (
    length(
      x
    ) ==
      0 ||
    all(
      is.na(
        x
      )
    )
  ) {
    return(
      NA_real_
    )
  }
  mean(
    x,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}
median_safe <- function(
    x
) {
  if (
    length(
      x
    ) ==
      0 ||
    all(
      is.na(
        x
      )
    )
  ) {
    return(
      NA_real_
    )
  }
  median(
    x,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}
# Summary by true model size, method and estimator
model_size_summary <- identification_results %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    s_true,
    method,
    estimator
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    replications =
      dplyr::n(),
    estimate_availability =
      mean(
        estimate_available,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    # Unavailable estimates count as unsuccessful because
    # make_identification_row() records correct = FALSE when
    # an estimate is unavailable.
    correct_identification_rate =
      mean(
        correct,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    correct_given_available =
      if (
        sum(
          estimate_available,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ) >
          0
      ) {
        mean(
          correct[
            estimate_available
          ],
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
    MAE =
      mean_safe(
        absolute_error
      ),
    Bias =
      mean_safe(
        signed_error
      ),
    mean_estimated_size =
      mean_safe(
        s_hat
      ),
    median_estimated_size =
      median_safe(
        s_hat
      ),
    .groups =
      "drop"
  )
print(
  model_size_summary
)
write.csv(
  model_size_summary,
  file.path(

)
```

```{r}
# Section 18
# CPLEX optimality and runtime diagnostics
cplex_status_summary <- path_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    method ==
      "CPLEX"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    s_true,
    k
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    fitted_runs =
      dplyr::n(),
    successful_runs =
      sum(
        success,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    optimal_rate =
      if (
        sum(
          !is.na(
            cplex_status
          )
        ) >
          0
      ) {
        mean(
          grepl(
            "optimal",
            cplex_status[
              !is.na(
                cplex_status
              )
            ],
            ignore.case = TRUE
          )
        )
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
    maximum_gap =
      if (
        all(
          is.na(
            cplex_gap
          )
        )
      ) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        max(
          cplex_gap,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      },
    median_runtime =
      median_safe(
        runtime
      ),
    .groups =
      "drop"
  )
print(
  cplex_status_summary
)
write.csv(
```

```{r}
# Section 20
# Correct model-size identification rate
correct_plot_data <- identification_results %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    s_true,
    method,
    estimator
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    correct_rate =
      mean(
        correct,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    n =
      dplyr::n(),
    .groups =
      "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    se =
      sqrt(
        correct_rate *
          (
            1 -
              correct_rate
          ) /
          n
      ),
    lower =
      pmax(
        0,
        correct_rate -
          1.96 *
            se
      ),
    upper =
      pmin(
        1,
        correct_rate +
          1.96 *
            se
      )
  )
p_correct <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  correct_plot_data,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x =
      s_true,
    y =
      correct_rate,
    group =
      estimator,
    linetype =
      estimator,
    shape =
      estimator
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
    ggplot2::aes(
      ymin =
        lower,
      ymax =
        upper
    ),
    width =
      0.08
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(
    ~ method
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    breaks =
      true_sizes
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(
      0,
      1
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x =
      "True model size",
    y =
      "Correct model-size identification rate",
    linetype =
      "Estimator",
    shape =
      "Estimator"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
print(
  p_correct
)
ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename =
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      "model_size_recovery_rate.png"
    ),
  plot =
    p_correct,
  width =
    10,
  height =
    6,
  dpi =
    300
)
```

```{r}
# Section 21
# Model-size MAE and bias
# Mean absolute error
```

```{r}
example_threshold_data <- diagnostic_curves %>%
```

```{r}
    "estimated_size_distribution.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# L0Learn successful model-size identification runs
l0learn_worked <- identification_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    method == "L0Learn"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    s_true,
    estimator
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_simulations =
      dplyr::n(),
    worked =
      sum(
        estimate_available,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    failed =
      sum(
        !estimate_available,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    proportion_worked =
      mean(
        estimate_available,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(
  l0learn_worked
)
```
